reviews.text: They were very polite and friendly, thorough, explained everything in detail. Even our cat was chill around them...we were happy to meet the new doctor; she called personally with test results.
Incredible and honest staff that helped my Husky out when he wasn't doing so great -- 10/10 would recommend!

The staff was always kind and caring with my dog. Unfortunately, after years of visits, medications, prescription food, and thousands of dollars spent, her chronic skin infections and severe ear problems never improved.

We were repeatedly told to avoid chicken, keep her on hydrolyzed food, and that she needed to lose weight and exercise more.

Eventually, I stopped that approach and switched her to real food  chicken, pork, meat, and vegetables. Over a year later, she has had no skin infections or ear problems, lost weight, is no longer puffy, and is incredibly athletic.

I can only speak from our experience, but when the same veterinary approach isn’t working for years, it’s time to reassess and try something different  not continue charging clients for the same cycle of visits, medications, and treatments without lasting results while the animal continues to suffer. I really wish a different approach had been considered much sooner.

I've been bringing my dogs here as a second option for a bit as my primary vet was booked up and I don't believe I'll be coming back.

There seems to be a disconnect between the front office and the vet staff because there's always issues. I called to get a prescription, I was told to come get it after 5PM, I showed up at 5:30PM and they were closed already. Normally I wouldn't have an issue with this but they specifically told me to come after 5PM and they close at 6PM. This lead to my dogs not having their medicine over the weekend. Most recently, I've been asking them to call in a prescription to Costco and they never did, leaving my dogs without their medicine again. Two times in the last month they have been left without their medication because of miscommunication or inaction.

I had to ask three times for a quotes for care and finally got it after the third and the quoted price is significantly more than my primary vet offers. The people are nice but leaving my dogs uncomfortable over and over and lacking follow up and communication is enough for me to wait the longer times for my primary vet.
Can not say enough good things about this veterinary practice. Saw Dr. Burke and loved her- all the techs and front desk are incredibly kind as well. Very reasonably priced, on time, and caring.

Very satisfied. Called and got a appointment within 1hr. It was our first visit and with their promotion for 1st time customer's consultation was free. The Doctor and staff were very knowledgeable and friendly. They found the problem with our dog and sold us medication to remedy it. Would definitely go back and recomend them to friends.

I have been coming to Shelter Island Veterinary Hospital since I got my Akita from the shelter.  Everyone is amazing.  The front desk is always so friendly, accommodating when we come.  Everyone knows that larger dogs tend to be overlooked because of their power or how they may intimidate.  But they always come to her and make her feel welcome.

The medical professionals from Vet assistants, to the techs and all veterinarians have been amazing.  Our dog has been loved, cared for, and treated like if they were her family.

Thank you for being apart of our Nikita's Ohana.

Love the new vet Dr.Burke,She called me the day before to discuss my dogs anxiety issues, which was very helpful and so sweet of her, when we got there , they took us in right away and she explained everything in terms we would understand, never tried to up sell us on stuff we didn’t really need and was so patient with My Sweet Joey that has to be muzzled, we left there feeling she listened to everything we said , and her plan we pray will help ❤️

Thank you, Charles, for the 5-star review and for choosing Shelter Island Veterinary Hospital. We appreciate your support and are glad you had a great experience with our team. We look forward to seeing you again, and don't forget you can conveniently book appointments through the Yourgi app.

If you know a fellow pet parent looking for veterinary care, we'd be honored if you referred them to our hospital. Thank you for being part of our Shelter Island family.

I highly reccomend Dr Courtney Maret. My dog has previous vet trauma and is VERY fearful during exams and treatment. She was kind, understanding and knowledgeable. She had patience with my dog and modified when needed to make it a better experience while still getting through necessary treatment. I’m not sure our techs name but she was so sweet and did a great job as well. I’m so grateful to find someone who I can trust to alleviate stress when coming to the vet.

I came in for a nail trim for my dog who HATES nail trims. I have tried for years to do it myself but can’t. I was embarrassed to come in only for a nail trim but the techs were amazing! They took their time to make sure my baby wasn’t too stressed. I am so grateful for them and will be coming back. I wish I remembered their names! 3 female vet assistants helped me.
I moved to this vet this week. How refreshing to have a dr that cares and listens and isn’t rushed. Thank you.
Dr durr was amazing and very helpful

We had a really great experience here today with our new puppy Melon. I don’t know if our vets name is Dr. Pearson or if that was his first name but he was super friendly and encouraging as a first time dog mom. I really appreciated how understanding everyone was of all of my questions! Abby the vet assistant was great with both our dog and my kids! Thank you ☺️
Caring and very professional explaining to me what was wrong with my dog.

Thank you Kristine Martin for your wonderful review!  We enjoyed having both of you at Shelter Island Veterinary Hospital. We look forward to seeing you both again soon for all your veterinary services :)

I had a great experience at this vet. I was on the hunt for a new vet clinic for my baby because of a bad experience at another vet. The lobby was welcoming and inviting and I was put into a room very quickly by the vet staff. My baby was seen by Dr. Durr for a skin infection. He was very thorough with his exam. The vet assistant kept my baby calm throughout the exam. I will definitely be returning to this location for care. Thank you shelter island!

Took my dog to get a lump checked out, results showed a mast cell tumor and it was recommended we see a specialist regarding surgery and they wanted to refer me because they couldn’t do it in-house. Upon requesting records / referral to be sent to me, it took multiple calls on my end to finally receive her records. Then suddenly they ARE able to do her surgery in-house, and wanted to schedule a consultation for $685+ before deciding further steps regarding a procedure. I understand vets are costly, but for the lack of communication and care, I’ll spend the money elsewhere to get better quality treatment.

Update: I received amazing care at VSH Sorrento Valley, where the same exact consultation was $250. I highly recommend searching for alternative places for better treatment!!

I have been in the market for a new vet for my pup. I am so glad I found this facility. They made me an appointment same day. Alicia was my tech and she was amazing every step of the way. Dr Evelyn was also lovely. I am so glad we have a new vet!!

Hello Kate,

Thank you for taking the time to submit a review. We are saddened that you had a poor experience with us and apologize greatly for that. We can understand how frustrating and upsetting this was for you. Furthermore, we would love to correct the experience and provide you with a satisfactory resolution, as you are a valued and important customer. We strive to provide an exceptional guest experience for both our pets and pet parents. Because we fell short of our service commitment, we would love to connect with you to correct our mistakes. Please feel free to reach out to the Manager; we would love to speak to you. If you prefer to speak with our District Director, we would be happy to coordinate that as well. We appreciate you choosing us for your pet needs and for taking the time to let us know how we are doing.

Hello Tracy,

We appreciate the kind review! Here at Shelter Island Veterinary Hospital, our top priority is providing a 5-Star guest and pet experience, and we would love to know how we can earn 5 stars next time. Also, if you would ever like to get your pup pampered, we can make your daycare visit a "pamper and play". Your furry friend will come home tired and smelling great! Thank you again, and we look forward to seeing you soon.

-Team Shelter Island Vet
This the best veterinary hospital, I have ever been too ! Everyone is so sweet and caring .My little fur baby and I ,felt right at home and we received an appointment right away ,no waiting !!

I adopted 2 kittens from a cat rescue in Los Angeles over 3 weeks ago. My normal vet was on vacation and i wanted to get my kitten checked out for ringworm. She had a scab and hair loss. This was my first time at Shelter Island Vet. They saw my kitten even though I told them I have my regular vet that I have used for 8 years. Even though they new this they still gave great care! Yes, my kitten has ringworm. So if anyone is looking for a new vet I recommend Shelter Island Veterinary! I will be using them as my back up vet.

We brought our elderly cat here who has anxiety when leaving the house. We needed some bloodwork done as well as a routine check up. Upon arriving, a nice assistant escorted us to the waiting room where he performed some basic tests without …
Your review brightened our day!  Thank you D Staiyer for your support, and we can't wait to welcome you and your pet back to Shelter Island Veterinary Hospital :)

Everyone treated us great and got my amazing senior Luna back to running. Elizabeth is such an amazing manager who keeps the hospital great. Lizzie an amazing receptionist who made us feel with confidence that Luna was going to be great. …

They ruptured our cats ear drum when cleaning. Said nothing. Came home and our cat couldn't walk, was falling everywhere, and not eating. They still haven't returned our calls after a week. I wouldnt bring your pets here. You just can't trust someone who doesn't own up to their mistakes and try to fix them.

I brought my dogs here for three visits and left disappointed each time. I didn’t feel comfortable with the staff as they felt cold. the doctor every time said she couldn’t do a complete exam on my dog because he was difficult, and still …

The doctors at Shelter Island veterinary hospital are fantastic. I find them fairly priced and very accommodating. This is my third pet. I’ve have  taking there. Will continue to use them as  my veterinarian!
